_note: v7.84 : Atelier 3D — pré-listes de la série, vue intérieure et première personne, nouvelles options (camouflage, style de jante, flancs, disposition des néons, plaques, intérieur, klaxons)
Pas de son dans l’Atelier : les 46 klaxo: No sound in the Workshop: the 46 horns of GTA V and GTA Online are in the pre-list, below the model.
Glisser pour regarder autour · molette o: Drag to look around · scroll or pinch for the field of view
Habitacle générique de l’Atelier : ni le: The Workshop’s generic cabin: neither the model’s dashboard nor its seats.
Guidon, rétroviseurs et compteur génériq: The Workshop’s generic handlebars, mirrors and gauge.
Les pré-listes reprennent ce que GTA V e: The pre-lists cover what GTA V and GTA Online offer (in-game names, colors from the game data) until GTA VI’s lists arrive. The interior view and first person show a generic cabin built on the windows of the schematic: neither the model’s dashboard nor its seats.
Choisis un véhicule ou une arme, fais-le: Pick a vehicle or a weapon, spin it, paint it, kit it out, climb aboard. Each option links to its entry in the customization catalog, with the series benchmark when there is one; the pre-lists show, workshop by workshop, what GTA V and GTA Online offer. The volumes are models built on the Leonidakit schematics, not the game’s models.
Tourne, peins et équipe chaque véhicule: Spin, paint and kit out every GTA VI vehicle and weapon in 3D, right down to the interior: paint, rims, neons, plate, finishes, sights, with the GTA V and GTA Online pre-lists and the series benchmark for each option.
Ce que GTA V et GTA Online proposent, at: What GTA V and GTA Online offer, workshop by workshop, until GTA VI’s lists arrive. Each list opens with a click; the swatches and underlined names can be tried on the model.
Pas de pré-liste pour cet atelier : ses: No pre-list for this workshop: its options are enough for the model.
La palette de Los Santos Customs, dans l: The Los Santos Customs palette, in menu order. Online adds “Crew Color”, the crew’s color.
Les mêmes 75 noms en finition métallisée: The same 75 names in a metallic finish; Midnight Purple and Gold take a different shade.
La finition mate a sa propre palette, pl: The matte finish has its own, shorter palette.
Les deux ors arrivent en ligne avec la m: The two golds arrived online with the “I’m Not a Hipster” update, at rank 100. Gold swatches: their reflection color in the game data.
Une couleur de reflet posée sur une pein: A reflection color laid over a metallic paint, chosen from the same 75-name palette. On the model, it shows in the reflections.
Peintures à reflets changeants des versi: Color-shifting paints from the PS5, Xbox Series and PC Enhanced versions. Their shades are not in the data consulted: the Workshop’s “Chameleon” finish gives the idea.
Le même jeu de livrées revient sur les v: The same set of liveries comes back on military vehicles (APC, Half-track, TM-02 Khanjali, Akula…). The underlined names can be tried on the model with a generic Workshop pattern: these are not the game’s liveries.
Benny’s, Open Wheel, Street et Track son: Benny’s, Open Wheel, Street and Track arrived with GTA Online. The Workshop’s rim style stays generic.
Each design in chrome or gold.
Chacune aussi en version rayée (« Stripe: Each also in a striped version (“Striped”); the family is called “Race” on the GTA Wiki.
Pour les motos ; roue avant et roue arri: For motorcycles; front and rear wheel chosen separately.
Les flancs blancs et les lignes de coule: The underlined white walls and colored lines can be tried on the model.
Patriot ne sort que pendant les événemen: Patriot only appears during Independence Day events; Crew, online, takes the crew’s color.
Les postes des motos custom de la mise à: The custom bike parts from the Bikers update (2016), grouped as on the GTA Wiki.
Le noir pur (« Pure Black »), vendu en l: Pure Black, sold online on PS3 and Xbox 360, disappeared from later versions.
Les néons existent depuis les versions P: Neons have existed since the PS4, Xbox One and PC versions.
Pastilles : les teintes des phares du mê: Swatches: the headlight shades of the same name in the game data. Online, “Crew” takes the crew’s color.
Arrivées avec Arena War, vendues aussi a: Added with Arena War, also sold at the LS Car Meet; shades from the game data.
eCola et Sprunk se posent sur tous les v: eCola and Sprunk fit every vehicle; the five other 2023 plates only appear on the salvage yard robbery vehicles. The North Yankton and “SA EXEMPT” plates cannot be chosen.
Les noms seulement, sans le son. Les air: Names only, no sound. The seasonal tunes (Halloween, the holidays, Independence Day) are only sold during their events.
La palette classique moins sept couleurs: The classic palette minus seven colors; it tints the seats, doors and dashboard of Benny’s models.
Cadrans, surpiqûres et détails (« Light: Dials, stitching and details (“Light Color” on the GTA Wiki).
Ce que Benny’s change dans l’habitacle d: What Benny’s changes inside the 31 models that can become lowriders.
Pour la plupart des armes à feu ; en lig: For most firearms; online, unlocked through kills and rank.
Les finitions des armes Mk II de l’ateli: The Mk II weapon finishes from the weapon workshop, often two-tone: they cannot be tried on the model.
Chaque camouflage se décline en 32 coule: Each camo comes in 32 colors. The underlined names can be tried with a generic Workshop pattern.
Chacune liée à quelques armes précises ;: Each tied to a few specific weapons; most arrived with the Lowriders update.
Les motifs de la batte de baseball vendu: The baseball bat patterns sold online.
Lunettes de vision nocturne et thermique: Night vision and thermal scopes: on the Heavy Sniper Mk II.
Sur les armes Mk II, le frein de bouche: On Mk II weapons, the muzzle brake comes in seven designs.
Les quatre cartouches sont celles du fus: The four shells belong to the Pump Shotgun Mk II; the explosive rounds to the Heavy Sniper Mk II.
Flancs des jantes Street et Track: Sidewalls for Street and Track rims
Gamme : huit notes, de do à do aigu: Scale: eight notes, from do to high do
